custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two parts for this test: part A, active and tracked, with 4 in its bin at a cost of $10.00, and part B, active and untracked, with 3 in its bin at a cost of $20.00.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value), with the as-of date on today.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425630-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425630-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • The Inventory Value report: Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value. Its As of: date, Category:, Vendor: and Location: filters sit above the table; Download (PDF) and Download (CSV) are in its three-dot menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 2:

  • Exactly one row is listed: part A, with Qty 4.00, Unit Cost $10.00 and Total Cost $40.00 (4 × $10.00 = $40.00).
  • There is no row for part B.
  • The Totals row reads Qty 4.00 and Total Cost $40.00: part B's 3 × $20.00 = $60.00 is not added, so the total is $40.00, not $100.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • S4-R9: “The Inventory Value report does not include untracked parts.”
  • Feature Overview, Accounting: “The Inventory Value report leaves out untracked parts, because they keep no stock count to value. This is a report change only.”
